# DropCatch.com
> Domain backordering, expired domain auctions, and domain portfolio management services.

DropCatch helps users acquire expiring and deleted domain names through backorders and public auctions, with supporting tools for account management, bidding, and domain operations.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.dropcatch.com/): Main entry point for DropCatch domain backordering and auction services.
- [Search](https://www.dropcatch.com/search): Search for domains available for backorder or auction.
- [Auctions](https://www.dropcatch.com/auctions): Browse active expired domain auctions and current bidding activity.
- [Backorder](https://www.dropcatch.com/backorder): Place backorders on expiring domains before they drop.
- [Catalog](https://www.dropcatch.com/catalog): Explore domain inventory and opportunities across available names.
- [Login](https://www.dropcatch.com/login): Access user accounts for bidding, backorders, and domain management.
- [Register](https://www.dropcatch.com/register): Create a new DropCatch account to use platform services.

## Auctions and Bidding
- [Active Auctions](https://www.dropcatch.com/auctions): View domains currently open for competitive bidding.
- [My Auctions](https://www.dropcatch.com/myauctions): Track auctions you are participating in or watching.
- [Auction Bids](https://www.dropcatch.com/bids): Review bids placed across active and completed auctions.
- [Watchlist](https://www.dropcatch.com/watchlist): Monitor domains of interest before bidding or backordering.
- [Search Results](https://www.dropcatch.com/search): Find auction and backorder candidates by keyword or domain.

## Backordering
- [Backorder Search](https://www.dropcatch.com/search): Search for expiring domains eligible for backorder placement.
- [Place Backorder](https://www.dropcatch.com/backorder): Submit a backorder request for a target domain.
- [My Backorders](https://www.dropcatch.com/mybackorders): Manage submitted backorders and monitor their status.
- [Pending Orders](https://www.dropcatch.com/pending): Review pending domain acquisition activity and outcomes.

## Account and Billing
- [Account Login](https://www.dropcatch.com/login): Sign in to manage auctions, backorders, and account settings.
- [Account Registration](https://www.dropcatch.com/register): Open a new account for bidding and domain acquisition.
- [My Account](https://www.dropcatch.com/myaccount): Update account details and platform preferences.
- [Billing](https://www.dropcatch.com/billing): Manage payment methods, balances, and billing activity.
- [Order History](https://www.dropcatch.com/orders): Review completed purchases, auction wins, and transactions.

## Domain Management
- [My Domains](https://www.dropcatch.com/mydomains): View domains acquired through DropCatch and related actions.
- [Transfers](https://www.dropcatch.com/transfers): Manage inbound or outbound domain transfer processes.
- [Nameservers](https://www.dropcatch.com/nameservers): Configure nameserver settings for managed domains.
- [DNS Management](https://www.dropcatch.com/dns): Maintain DNS records and domain resolution settings.
- [Renewals](https://www.dropcatch.com/renewals): Review and process domain renewal actions.

## Help and Support
- [Support](https://www.dropcatch.com/support): Contact DropCatch support for account and service assistance.
- [Help Center](https://www.dropcatch.com/help): Access general help resources and common support topics.
- [FAQ](https://www.dropcatch.com/faq): Find answers to common questions about auctions and backorders.
- [Contact](https://www.dropcatch.com/contact): Reach the company for service or account-related inquiries.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://www.dropcatch.com/terms): Review the terms governing use of DropCatch services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.dropcatch.com/privacy): Understand how personal data is collected and used.
- [Auction Terms](https://www.dropcatch.com/auctionterms): Read rules and conditions for auction participation.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.dropcatch.com/cookies): Learn about cookie usage and related controls on the site.

## Company Information
- [About](https://www.dropcatch.com/about): Overview of the company and its domain acquisition services.
- [Blog](https://www.dropcatch.com/blog): Updates, announcements, and domain industry-related posts.
- [News](https://www.dropcatch.com/news): Company news and service updates for customers.
- [Careers](https://www.dropcatch.com/careers): Employment opportunities and company hiring information.
